 Hannes Steinbach's Hornets return should jeopardize Sion James' starting spot 
 Steinbach has dominated in the G League. By Nathan Doyle | Nov 20, 2026, 1:00 PM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Charlotte, North Carolina, USA; Charlotte Hornets guard Sion James (4) warms up before the game against the Indiana Pacers at the Spectrum Center on January 8, 2026. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Hannes Steinbach and Sion James are on two different trajectories right now . While Steinbach has done much of his damage in the G League, there is positive noise around the young forward. On the other hand, James has seriously struggled to make an impact for the Charlotte Hornets this year. Now that it's confirmed his teammate has returned from the Greensboro Swarm, James' role should be under the spotlight.
--> Hannes Steinbach and Sion James are on two different trajectories right now . While Steinbach has done much of his damage in the G League, there is positive noise around the young forward. On the other hand, James has seriously struggled to make an impact for the Charlotte Hornets this year. Now that it's confirmed his teammate has returned from the Greensboro Swarm, James' role should be under the spotlight.
 Steinbach's role in Charlotte has been limited, but his performances for the Swarm have been simply incredible. The 20-year-old became the first player in G League history with 75+ points and 50+ rebounds. He led the league in rebounds per game (18), while recording 3 blocks per game. Steinbach is showing a relentless work rate that should buy him a larger role in the rotation. 
--> Steinbach's role in Charlotte has been limited, but his performances for the Swarm have been simply incredible. The 20-year-old became the first player in G League history with 75+ points and 50+ rebounds. He led the league in rebounds per game (18), while recording 3 blocks per game. Steinbach is showing a relentless work rate that should buy him a larger role in the rotation. 
 If Charles Lee wants to create a culture that rewards good behaviour, he can't ignore Steibach's G League outings. It may not match the elite standard of the NBA, but working hard at that level matters, especially when another player has failed to make a meaningful contribution to winning. 
--> If Charles Lee wants to create a culture that rewards good behaviour, he can't ignore Steibach's G League outings. It may not match the elite standard of the NBA, but working hard at that level matters, especially when another player has failed to make a meaningful contribution to winning. 
 James should have his rotational role reduced
--> James should have his rotational role reduced
 While Steinbach and James wouldn't be a like-for-like replacement, Charlotte's head coach has to try something new. Their inconsistent performances aren't disappearing quickly, and without Kon Knueppel available for selection, the Hornets are running low on quality frontcourt options. 
--> While Steinbach and James wouldn't be a like-for-like replacement, Charlotte's head coach has to try something new. Their inconsistent performances aren't disappearing quickly, and without Kon Knueppel available for selection, the Hornets are running low on quality frontcourt options. 
 James is more of an agile wing who can occupy a guard or forward spot, depending on what the team needs. Unfortunately for him, he has struggled in both positions this year. The 23-year-old is averaging 5.6 points, 4 rebounds, and 3.1 assists per game, shooting just 31.8 percent from the floor. James plays with energy, but his production simply doesn't match. 
--> James is more of an agile wing who can occupy a guard or forward spot, depending on what the team needs. Unfortunately for him, he has struggled in both positions this year. The 23-year-old is averaging 5.6 points, 4 rebounds, and 3.1 assists per game, shooting just 31.8 percent from the floor. James plays with energy, but his production simply doesn't match. 
 On paper, the Hornets should have an effective, balanced lineup when James shares the court with Naz Reid. In theory, it's a blend of physicality and speed, with two versatile shooters. However, the results are evidence enough that this hasn't been a good combination. Lee will find himself under pressure if he can't make an innovative adjustment soon, and he does have options.
--> On paper, the Hornets should have an effective, balanced lineup when James shares the court with Naz Reid. In theory, it's a blend of physicality and speed, with two versatile shooters. However, the results are evidence enough that this hasn't been a good combination. Lee will find himself under pressure if he can't make an innovative adjustment soon, and he does have options.
 Adding Steinbach to the lineup would be a gamble, but one that could ultimately pay dividends. The rookie stands at 6-foot-10, meaning his inclusion alongside Reid and Moussa Diabate would give Charlotte imposing size across the lineup. 
--> Adding Steinbach to the lineup would be a gamble, but one that could ultimately pay dividends. The rookie stands at 6-foot-10, meaning his inclusion alongside Reid and Moussa Diabate would give Charlotte imposing size across the lineup. 
 The Hornets would immediately lose mobility, but not necessarily shooting. With Reid, Brandon Miller, and Coby Williams on the floor, there should be enough shot-making and playmaking to amplify the team's offense . 
--> The Hornets would immediately lose mobility, but not necessarily shooting. With Reid, Brandon Miller, and Coby Williams on the floor, there should be enough shot-making and playmaking to amplify the team's offense . 
 Hard work and impressive performances should be rewarded. Steinbach has served his time in the G League and will undoubtedly return to the Hornets as a different animal. Lee would be making a huge mistake by disregarding his work ethic and continuing to utilise James so heavily in the rotation.
